flagged.evidence: The description says the diagram is the closure of the positive braid σ₁³ and that the right-to-left strand passes over. In the TikZ, the white gap is drawn on the left-to-right path from (-1,3) to (1,2), so that strand passes under; the right-to-left strand passes over. Under the standard Artin convention, σ₁ is the left-over-right crossing ([OSU braid-group notes](https://math.osu.edu/sites/math.osu.edu/files/BraidGroup.pdf)); its positive closure is the right-handed trefoil, while σ₁⁻³ closes to the left-handed trefoil ([Columbia knot-theory notes](https://www.math.columbia.edu/~khovanov/knottheory2012/hw3.pdf)). The drawing therefore depicts the mirror of the stated trefoil.
